start.title: [TODO:ru] Who Sinned?
start.text:
[TODO:ru] You sit in the dust, begging.
Disciples ask, "Who sinned?"

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Be Still
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Anger will not heal you.
Listen.

reveal.title: [TODO:ru] God's Works Revealed
reveal.text:
[TODO:ru] "Neither this man nor his parents."
"God's works shall be seen."

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Hold On
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] His voice is kind.
Hope a little.

mud.title: [TODO:ru] Mud on Your Eyes
mud.text:
[TODO:ru] He spits on the ground, makes clay.
His hand finds your face.

pull_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Be Still
pull_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] His touch is gentle.
Let him work.

wipe_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Trust His Hand
wipe_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Do not undo his work.
Wait.

send.title: [TODO:ru] Go to Siloam
send.text:
[TODO:ru] "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam."
The way is long.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You feel the wall, and go.

wash.title: [TODO:ru] The Pool of Siloam
wash.text:
[TODO:ru] Water in your hands.
You bring it to your eyes.

shut_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Open Your Eyes
shut_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He sent you to see.
Lift them.

see.title: [TODO:ru] You Can See
see.text:
[TODO:ru] Sky. Stone. Your own hands.
You weep, laughing.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Speak Out
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Do not hide his work.
Tell them.

pharisees.title: [TODO:ru] Pharisees Question You
pharisees.text:
[TODO:ru] They glare. "Who opened your eyes?"
The room is cold.

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Speak Truth
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Truth set you free.
Name him.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Find Your Voice
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He gave you sight.
Give him your words.

testify.title: [TODO:ru] One Thing I Know
testify.text:
[TODO:ru] "I was blind. Now I see."
The light stays with you.
